column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each operation/maintenance record.
A VARCHAR(60) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking operational data to a specific equipment unit.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing Location(LocationRegistry), associating this record with a location if applicable.
A NUMERIC(8,3) indicating the total hours the equipment has been in operation.
A NUMERIC(7,2) for the planned hours between maintenance events.
A DATE noting when the last maintenance was performed.
A DATE indicating the scheduled date for the next maintenance.
An enum (OperationalStatus_enum) showing the current operating state (e.g., Storage, Standby, Repair, Active, Maintenance).
An enum (CrewCertificationStatus_enum) indicating crew status (e.g., Valid, Pending, Expired).
An enum (InspectionStatus_enum) for the result of any recent inspection (e.g., Failed, Passed, Pending).
An enum (ComplianceStatus_enum) describing overall compliance (e.g., Review, Non-compliant, Compliant).
An enum (DocumentationStatus_enum) indicating if documentation is (e.g., Updated, Incomplete, Complete).
An INTEGER optionally linking to a record in Communication or another table if referenced (not enforced here).

JSONB column. Aggregates financial metrics related to maintenance, repair, and operating costs.
Fields: {"maintenance_usd":"A DECIMAL(8,2) for the cost (in USD) of recent or typical maintenance.","operating_usd":"A NUMERIC(9,4) indicating the ongoing operating cost (in USD).","repair_usd":"A DECIMAL(9,3) for the cost (in USD) of repairs, if any."}
